description_en: Retrieves detailed property information, including the property ID, based on the domain, application name, resource ID, and property name. Other API operations depend on this operation to obtain the property ID
description_zh: 根据域,、应用名、资源 ID、属性名称获取属性详细信息，包含属性 ID。其它接口都依赖此接口获取属性 ID
kebab_example: aliyun sofa query-ms-config-attributes --app-name demo-app --attribute-name age --instance-id abcdEFGH1234 --biz-region Alipay --resource-id com.alipay.test --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMsConfigAttributes

parameters.help_en: The environment instance ID. This is a system field
parameters.help_zh: 系统字段：环境实例 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain to which the resource belongs
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The resource ID, similar to a file name
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID，类似于文件名
parameters.name: resource_id
